ada:samplingUnitName: Labelled sections: "UT1 to UT3 (formerly referred to as MT-1, MT-2, MT-3)" (p.3). LA-ICP-MS results are averages ("n = 7", "n = 13", table p.9); individual analyses are in "Table S1 in supporting information" (p.7), not in the archived PDF
ada:analysisInclusionAndRejectionCriteri: Partially — the reported values are means of stated counts ("n = 7", "n = 13", table p.9). No acceptance or rejection rule is stated; the plateau-region screening of each spot is signal-based and is recorded under Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
ada:detectionLimit: Referenced in Table 3 and Table S1; specific values not directly stated in main text; REE in olivines below detection limits at 24–32 µm conditions
ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: For silicates: oxide-sum normalization agrees within <10% with EMP-based IS method (internal cross-check, not a separate QC standard)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Petrographic microscopy, SEM and EMP — "The petrography of these sections was examined using a petrographic microscope and a scanning electron microscope", followed by BSE images and element maps (p.3); the EMP results then serve as internal standards for the ablation data, which are normalised using "EMP CaO or MgO values" for silicates and "40Ca counts to CaO concentrations from the EMP analysis" for phosphate (p.4)
